lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Sorry, Gus. Nothing on me right now.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: No worries, kid. Folks round here look out for me. I've watched this stretch of Venice for eleven years. I know every crack in this pavement.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Here's a tip: rails love speed. Jump early, hold the button, and don't brake mid-grind.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: And watch out for the pothole past the market. It's got a grudge against skaters.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Go on, then. Show me something good.

repeat_lines.speaker: gus
repeat_lines.text: Hey man! Got any food yet?

repeat_lines.speaker: ethan
repeat_lines.text: Not yet, Gus. I'll keep an eye out.

repeat_lines.speaker: gus
repeat_lines.text: Speed first, then jump. The rest is just style.
